narrative_purpose: Show that the Na'vi's luminous freckles are organs laid out along the body's vascular and neural lines in bilateral pairs — anchoring the canon point that the pattern is anatomical, steady, and gene-placed, not decorative.
subject: A naturalist study of a Na'vi face, neck and shoulders at night, the blue skin marked with fine cyan-white luminous dots arranged in clear bilateral lines that trace the paths of veins and nerves across the brow, cheekbones, jaw, throat and collarbone; the dots glowing steadily with a soft from-within light.
scene: A dark, neutral study background so the photophore pattern reads clearly, faint teal haze at the edges.
camera: A near-frontal portrait study, slightly turned, head and upper shoulders filling the frame.
light: Low ambient indigo with the photophores themselves as the bioluminescent key; the dots cast a faint blue-white glow onto the surrounding skin.
palette: Deep indigo-teal skin shadow, Na'vi blue mid-tones, Pandora cyan-white in the glowing dots; strictly monochrome glow, no multi-colour photophores.
style: Painterly naturalist anatomical study, hand-painted texture, calm and observed.
detail_level: Crisp on the dot pattern and the bilateral lines they follow; background and far shoulder softening into haze.
composition: Head and shoulders centred, the bilateral symmetry of the dot lines emphasised, generous dark negative space around.
consistency_notes: Photophore light is a single blue-white hue throughout; placement strictly bilateral and following vessel/nerve lines; cool Pandora palette consistent with the cover.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no multi-coloured glow, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
